headline: Ground delays are holding flights into San Francisco.

items.text: A ground delay program is holding flights into San Francisco until 8:59 PM PT because of low clouds. Delays average 45 minutes, up to 110 minutes.
The other United hubs are running normally. All seven hubs reporting so far are at 84% on time or better, where on time means within 30 minutes of schedule.
A ground delay program is also holding flights into Seattle until 9:59 PM PT, with delays averaging 32 minutes, up to 82 minutes.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to San Francisco or Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
